annotations.title: Get an employer's litigation track record

description: Given an employer/company name, return distinct federal cases and trusted published employment opinions that involve that employer, the breakdown of outcomes (employee wins, employer wins, settlements, dismissals), the most notable recent opinions, AND the count of federal docket records on file (cases that may not have a written opinion). Use this when a user names their employer and wants that company's litigation history + footprint.

employer.description: Employer/company name to look up, e.g. "Walmart", "Acme Corporation". Common suffixes like Inc/Corp/LLC are ignored when matching.

limit.description: Number of example published opinions to return (1–25). The total count and outcome breakdown reflect the full corpus, not just these examples.

name: get_employer_track_record

_attribution.description: Source and disclaimer for this result: Workers' Rights, its URL, the attribution line, and that the result is educational information, not legal advice.

cases.description: Same rows as opinions, kept for compatibility.

dockets.description: Federal docket records: total and the newest filings.

opinions.description: Recent published opinions with court, date, outcome and link.

outcomesNotCounted.description: Opinions whose outcome could not be classified.

recordType.description: The record type the opinion counts describe.

total.description: Published employment opinions on file (same as totalOpinions).

title: Get an employer's litigation track record
